rationale: Repair the existing guarded Star Comprehensive pilot so an AUTHORITY_CLARIFICATION_REQUIRED enforcement result remains fail-closed for the ordinary decision path but is projected into the already-supported CLARIFICATION_REQUIRED customer response shape and passed through the existing Rendering Exit Safety boundary. This closes the P1E released-text observability gap without adding new insurance semantics, recommendation authority, payment authority, claim authority, or a new safety layer.
supersession_impact: No capability is superseded and no historical certification record is reinterpreted. The existing guarded Star pilot remains the certified runtime; only its unresolved-authority exit is repaired to release a governed clarification rather than raise before customer-visible response projection.
authority_impact: Authority is unchanged and remains fail-closed. AUTHORITY_CLARIFICATION_REQUIRED still prevents the ordinary decision gate from executing and cannot emit a payment, coverage, admissibility, or claim outcome. ADVISORY_PATH_NOT_AUTHORIZED remains blocked. The repair only exposes deterministic clarification text through the existing response contract and Rendering Exit Safety exact-preservation path.
